# Cache / Artifact Inventory

Scope: every file currently under `cache/`, `exp/eval/`, and `exp/inference/`. No files were deleted.

Category policy:
- `KEEP_PROD`: required to replay or preserve R54c production artifacts and immediate predecessor chain.
- `KEEP_DEV`: required or useful for dev evaluation/CV5 baselines and reusable local indices.
- `KEEP_EXP`: archived post-R54c experiment outputs worth retaining as evidence.
- `PURGEABLE`: generated intermediates, duplicated per-run caches, API caches, debug dumps, old submissions, or bulky archived models that can be regenerated.

Regen cost policy: `free` = script/eval rerun from retained inputs; `compute` = material CPU/GPU time or embedding/model rebuild; `API` = external API call/cache required for exact regeneration.
